title: Late save A closes a newer card B dialog
reproduction: Use isolated synthetic qa-a and qa-b records with a delayed onUpdate callback.
Open A, click Save, dismiss A, open B before save A resolves.
A persists successfully, then its stale onOpenChange(false) dismisses B.
expected: Save A must complete with the original CAS; stale UI callbacks must not close or mutate the newer dialog.
fix: Scope async UI callbacks to one open card generation; invalidate on close, card change, and unmount.
verification: Hydrated React/Radix via actual CDP clicks on loopback fixtures; no production data or authenticated server owner transition used.
related_path: ResultVerification late onSaved had the same baseline defect and now uses the same lifetime guard with card-keyed remount.
checks: ESLint passed for all four changed TypeScript files
Next production webpack build including TypeScript passed
browser_results: CDP Save A with 30-second delay, dismiss A, open B: A saved v2 with expectedVersion1; B stayed open v1; no stale close callback.
CDP owner close A with 30-second delay, dismiss A, open B: fixture policy completed A done/v2; B stayed open with no stale saved, refresh or close callback.
Owner close 403 and409 responses: A stayed open todo/v1 and showed the appropriate error.
CDP result verification A submit followed by explicit fixture parent navigation to B before delayed response: A completed done/v2; B stayed open with no stale saved, refresh or close callback.
limitations: Browser acceptance used genuine React/Radix and production pure transition policies with synthetic qa-a/qa-b/qa-owner fixtures on loopback. It did not test authenticated Next API owner transitions, persistent storage or production deployment.
Hydrated mobile viewport stability not established; static390px layout was verified in the parent UI change.
